verdict.rationale: A processor has no service API in the SaaS sense, but Intel documents first-party programming interfaces for this chip's compute engines. OpenVINO documents an NPU inference device for offloading neural-network work, and oneAPI/oneDNN/SYCL target Core Ultra Series 2 CPUs, GPUs and NPUs. These are toolkit APIs for running AI workloads on the hardware, not a public API for driving the product as a whole, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec. Missing for 10: a product-level documented control API, any OpenAPI or machine-readable spec, agent-oriented API docs, and hands-on corroboration of driving the 258V programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Neural Processing Unit is a low-power hardware solution, introduced with the Intel® Core™ Ultra generation of CPUs (formerly known as Meteor Lake). It enables you to offload certain neural network computation tasks from other devices

Maximize AI PC inference capabilities from large language models (LLM) to image generation with Intel® oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library (oneDNN) and PyTorch optimizations for Intel® Core™ Ultra processors (series 2) and Intel® Arc™ GPUs.
